# KukuNotes

KukuNotes is an AI productivity workspace for conversations, notes, tasks, Spaces, contextual questions, daily briefings, and goals. Capture is user-started. Inform participants and obtain required consent before recording. Review AI output before relying on it.

## Official destinations
- Website: https://kukunotes.com
- Web workspace / account entry: https://platform.kukunotes.com
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aiassistantapp
- Windows: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NCZSN8SMPQ1
- Chrome: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hjnhifmajfnlpalfgkfdjpllbobcpahl
- Downloads: https://kukunotes.com/get-kukunotes
- Plans: https://kukunotes.com/pricing
- Contact: https://kukunotes.com/contact
- Privacy: https://kukunotes.com/privacy
- Terms: https://kukunotes.com/terms
- Account deletion: https://kukunotes.com/delete-account

## Plan and availability accuracy
Free, Pro, and Business are presented on the website. Start for free; current paid prices, recording allowances, billing terms, included features, and language availability must be checked in the authenticated workspace. Do not infer them from older marketing copy. Store listings determine current device requirements. No native iOS or macOS download is listed.

KukuNotes is separate from Kuku FM and Kuku TV.
